Devon H: heads up — payments-bot put acct_540 on a temporary hold after a velocity/risk trigger, invoice INV-3321 paused. probable card-testing pattern, please advise.
payments-bot: Auto-hold initiated. Reason: multiple declines then successful auth. Risk score: 0.87. Events: txn_994, txn_995, txn_997. Flags: high-velocity, BIN-proxy-match. See /internal/payments/holds/1719004567
Lucy - Finance: copying in finance — can someone paste the full txns + AVS/CVV/auth responses and any IPs or device IDs? I can start a dispute packet but need clear evidence bits.
Matt S: support transcript attached: https://redwood.internal/support/threads/1229 — customer says they didn’t authorize, signed up yesterday. short convo, nothing suspicious in language but acct created 3m before purchase.
Devon H: txns below, card obfuscated: `**** **** **** 4242`
```
txn_994 2024-05-18T21:08:12Z auth=00 cvv=U avs=N ip=3.128.14.5 fp=dfp_77a3
txn_995 2024-05-18T21:09:03Z auth=05 cvv=N avs=N ip=34.201.21.7 fp=dfp_77a3
txn_997 2024-05-18T21:12:03Z auth=00 cvv=N avs=Y ip=3.128.14.5 fp=dfp_77a3
```
Lucy - Finance: quick notes — AVS:Y on the last one, CVV mostly N which is bad. Auth codes 00/05 (05 = do not honor). We can still submit evidence: auth logs, AVS response, IPs, support transcript, signup metadata, TOS checkbox. Need confirmation that we captured click-through and any billing descriptor.
Matt S: confirmed TOS checkbox recorded at 2024-05-18T21:07:50Z in audit: event_5557 (link: https://redwood.internal/audit/event_5557). Billing descriptor sent: REDWOOD*PROVISION
Devon H: payments-bot — any 3DS payload or full device fp export?
payments-bot: 3DS not present for these txns. Device fingerprint: dfp_77a3ab9c. Risk engine notes: BIN proxy similarity to known proxy list v2.4. Attaching match id: proxy_match_442.
Lucy - Finance: OK. I'll assemble dispute packet with: auth log, AVS response, device fp, support transcript, TOS audit, billing descriptor. If processor needs more (signature, shipping) we'll follow up. @Matt S can you add the screenshot of the support claim + customer email creation timestamp?
Matt S: added screenshot and user metadata to the ticket: email created 2024-05-18T21:04:30Z, IPs match auth. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/assets/ss_1229.png :thumbsup:
Lucy - Finance: uploading evidence to processor now. Reference dispute_2024_3321. Also flagging for chargeback team — hold on INV-3321 will remain until dispute resolves (7-45 days depending). I'll update here when processor responds.
Devon H: thanks. if processor declines our evidence, plan B is refund & mark invoice reversible. tagging @collections for FYI.
Matt S: noted. closing loop on support side.
payments-bot: Hold remains active. If new attempts detected, escalation will auto-notify fraud@redwood.com.
Lucy - Finance: packet uploaded at 2024-05-18T21:14:49Z. I'll post updates. :white_check_mark:
